snippet.title: RED FLAG | Official Game Announcement
snippet.description:
A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

Add to wishlist using the link in the pinned comment!
